description: The plot illustrates how mean interclass similarity varies across a sequence of indexed points for three experimental settings, with corresponding horizontal dashed lines indicating each setting’s average. The x-axis is unlabeled and appears linear, spanning approximately from 0 to about 65 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis is labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 with evenly spaced ticks of 0.1. Three solid lines with small point markers are shown: a blue line with circular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo,” an orange line with circular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” and a green line with circular markers labeled “DPO.” The blue series starts near 0.22 at x=0, spikes to about 0.48 at x=1, then fluctuates mostly between roughly 0.03 and 0.27 across the remaining x-values, with another prominent peak near x≈31 reaching about 0.48 and ending near about 0.02 at the final x. The orange series starts near 0.16 at x=0, varies widely with multiple peaks, including values around 0.39 near x≈16, about 0.46 near x≈31, about 0.43 near x≈33, and a late spike near x≈60 reaching about 0.46, and it ends around 0.07–0.08. The green series starts near 0.18 at x=0, stays within a narrower band (roughly ~0.03 to ~0.18) with small local rises (e.g., around x≈22 near ~0.18 and around x≈45 near ~0.16), and finishes near ~0.08. Three dashed horizontal average lines match the series colors and are annotated on the left: blue “Average of w/o DPO obo” at 0.107, orange “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” at 0.158, and green “Average of DPO” at 0.086.
